payload.body: Your next run, after step 2 lands (ic's shots and cc's known-defects page, which vc commits): the batch's one bin/devbin gate all and one bin/devbin test shell at main's HEAD (hv decision 100), each on a Desk slot that you ask devbin-vc for, one after the other and never beside a kovacs run (hv decision 45). vc sends you the HEAD to run at. Report each START and END with its log. A red: report its cause to vc, and nothing is re-run without vc's word. After both are green comes the close: wp done and ac satisfy for your packages, on vc's word. The reference set is already on main (0d64a1e16).
